projects.name: TheCustomNest
projects.description: A bespoke e-commerce platform designed and built for TheCustomNest, an artisan crochet brand. Engineered with dynamic category navigation, interactive product catalogs, an intuitive responsive cart drawer, and custom brand storytelling tailored to handcrafted goods.
projects.clientFeedback: Alpha Encoders took our artisanal brand and elevated it to a high-converting digital boutique. Our mobile checkout speed doubled and customers constantly praise how smooth the shopping experience is.
projects.verifiedResult: Deployed custom e-commerce experience with sub-second page loads (0.38s FCP) and zero layout shifts across mobile and desktop.
highlights: Multi-category filtering for custom crochet collections with instant client-side state
Frictionless slide-out cart drawer with instant quantity controls and optimistic updates
Handcrafted aesthetic tailored to boutique artisan goods with warm typography
Sub-second image loading with responsive WebP delivery and blur placeholders
Zero-dependency lightweight checkout inquiry pathway with spam mitigation
projects.architectureOverview: Built with modular React and TypeScript components, prioritizing fast initial bundle delivery and lightweight state management. Custom SVG accents and responsive image optimization ensure snappy performance on all mobile networks without heavy CMS overhead.

Syntax-highlighted interactive code modules with instant copy-paste developer ergonomics

Accessible dark-mode developer console layout engineered for high technical engagement

projects.name: EduSphere
projects.tagline: Modern Academic Platform & Learning Resource Portal
projects.description: A digital academic platform created to structure complex educational courses, learning modules, and student resources into an accessible, intuitive interface. Provides prospective students with transparent curriculum breakdowns and instant admissions inquiries.
projects.clientFeedback: The structured taxonomy and accessible high-contrast design transformed how our prospective students explore degree syllabi. Enrollment inquiries jumped by 42% in the first month.
projects.verifiedResult: Engineered an accessible, high-contrast academic resource system with streamlined student intake pathways and 100% WCAG AA compliance.
highlights: Intuitive curriculum explorer with expandable syllabus breakdowns and credit calculators
Structured faculty and course discovery taxonomy with instant search
Accessible, high-contrast typography adhering strictly to WCAG AA guidelines
Integrated enrollment inquiry and prospectus download flow with input validation
Client-side routing with smooth micro-transitions and zero screen flicker
projects.architectureOverview: Engineered with clean separation of concerns, structured JSON curriculum data schemas, and accessible semantic HTML. Designed for high readability across varying device sizes and assistive technologies.
